(12) She unboxes a "Fried Noodles" character, which is in a takeout-style box with a price tag sticker on the back. (13) She opens an "Onigiri" (rice ball) themed figure, featuring Labubu wearing sunglasses and holding a small soy sauce bottle. (14) She reveals a "Yakitori" themed figure, consisting of three small character heads on a skewer. (15) Finally, she opens a "Canned Sardine" themed figure, showing Labubu sleeping inside a silver tin with a fish. The video ends with a montage of these figures displayed on her shelf.

(4) The speaker's arousal peaks as she reacts to the plush shrimp, using high-pitched exclamations.
